Class FakeApplicationGenerator

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.fake.FakeApplicationGenerator
@Service public class FakeApplicationGenerator extends Object
Builds fake applications for Developer Mode (issue #219). Each one satisfies every rule a real application is held to (the required answers of issues #213 and #214, and enough prior coursework), so it can travel the whole path from review to hiring decisions. All randomness comes from the Random passed in, so a seeded generator gives the same applications every time.

Coursework terms run back from the quarter today falls in, the latest course taking that quarter. Graduation is counted from the recruitment's own year.
